verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a Fly.io feature for separating non-production environments from production services, such as per-environment private networks or org-level network isolation. The only related material covers Sprite egress policies and per-Sprite service access grants for agent sandboxes. Those are adjacent controls, not a documented capability for isolating environments, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
